title: 諾曼第大橋~Pont de Normandie
focus: 以近塔混凝土、跨中鋼箱梁的混合主梁與倒 Y 形塔，把斜張橋跨徑推進到 856 m~Pushing the cable-stayed span to 856 m with a hybrid concrete-near-pylon, steel-at-midspan deck and inverted-Y pylons
summary: 諾曼第大橋 1995 年通車時以 856 m 主跨創下斜張橋紀錄：主跨中央 624 m 為正交異性鋼箱梁，兩端各 116 m 與背跨為預力混凝土，184 根鋼絞線斜索掛在兩座約 214 m 高的倒 Y 形混凝土塔上。本課從混合主梁的重量配置、倒 Y 形塔的抗扭貢獻、斜索與樁基，經混凝土平衡懸臂與鋼節段吊裝，到現地風量測、長索振動與阻尼器加裝、斜索多層防腐與單股更換。~When it opened in 1995 the Pont de Normandie set the cable-stayed span record at 856 m: the central 624 m of the main span is an orthotropic steel box, while 116 m at each end and the back spans are prestressed concrete, and 184 strand stays hang from two inverted-Y concrete pylons about 214 m tall. The course runs from the weight layout of the hybrid deck, the torsional contribution of the inverted-Y pylons, stays and piles, through concrete balanced cantilevers and steel-segment lifting, to on-site wind measurement, long-stay vibration and retrofitted dampers, multi-layer stay corrosion protection and single-strand replacement.

units.anchor: 跨中 624 m 鋼箱梁~Central 624 m steel box
units.title: 混合主梁：近塔用混凝土、跨中用鋼~Hybrid deck: concrete near the pylons, steel at mid-span
units.mechanism: 諾曼第大橋的主跨 856 m 由三段組成：從塔向河中伸出的 116 m 混凝土懸臂，以及中央 624 m 的鋼箱梁。官方技術資料列出混凝土橋面每公尺約 33 至 50 t，鋼橋面只有約 8 至 11 t。斜張橋主跨的重量對塔的力矩與距離成正比，越遠的重量越「貴」：把輕的鋼梁放在力臂最長的跨中，把重的混凝土放在靠近塔、力臂短的位置，同時讓背跨的混凝土高架橋成為天然壓重。這種配置降低了塔與背跨錨固的需求，是當時能把跨徑大幅推進的關鍵。~The 856 m main span of the Pont de Normandie has three parts: a 116 m concrete cantilever reaching out from each pylon and a central 624 m steel box. The official technical sheet lists the concrete deck at about 33 to 50 t per metre and the steel deck at only about 8 to 11 t. Main-span weight acts on the pylon in proportion to its distance, so remote weight is the most costly: placing the light steel girder at mid-span where the lever arm is longest and the heavy concrete near the pylon where it is short, while the concrete back-span viaduct acts as natural ballast, reduces the demand on pylons and back-span anchorage. This layout was key to the large jump in span at the time.
units.model: 半個主跨對塔的力矩 M = Σ w·l·x̄。混凝土 116 m×40 t/m = 4,640 t，力臂 58 m，得 269,120 t·m；鋼梁 312 m×10 t/m = 3,120 t，力臂 116 + 156 = 272 m，得 848,640 t·m；合計約 1,117,760 t·m。若 428 m 全用 40 t/m 混凝土，M = 17,120×214 ≈ 3,663,680 t·m，約 3.3 倍。單位重取公開範圍內的教學值。~Half-span moment about the pylon M = Σ w·l·x̄. Concrete: 116 m×40 t/m = 4,640 t at 58 m gives 269,120 t·m; steel: 312 m×10 t/m = 3,120 t at 116 + 156 = 272 m gives 848,640 t·m; total about 1,117,760 t·m. If all 428 m were 40 t/m concrete, M = 17,120×214 ≈ 3,663,680 t·m, about 3.3 times larger. Unit weights are teaching values within the published ranges.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析逐段累積塔底彎矩與背跨支承反力，與鋼、混凝土實際秤重或體積換算的重量比對；混凝土段每節以實際澆置量更新重量，鋼節段出廠秤重，偏差超過容許時調整後續斜索力或背跨壓重。~Accumulate pylon-base moment and back-span reactions segment by segment in the staged analysis and compare with weights from actual steel weighing and concrete volumes; update each concrete segment with its as-cast volume, weigh steel segments at the factory, and adjust later stay forces or back-span ballast when deviations exceed tolerance.
units.failure: 若混凝土段實際重量高於設計（例如超厚或模板變形），塔身與背跨錨固承受額外彎矩，跨中鋼梁的線形也會隨之改變；鋼梁若因設計變更增重而未重算，塔頂偏位與斜索力會偏離預測。~If concrete segments end up heavier than designed, for example through over-thickness or formwork distortion, pylons and back-span anchorage take extra moment and the steel mid-span profile shifts; added steel weight from design changes not reanalysed pushes pylon-top displacement and stay forces away from prediction.
units.misconception: 大跨徑斜張橋的主梁全部用鋼最好，混凝土太重沒有用處。~An all-steel deck is always best for long cable-stayed spans; concrete is just dead weight.
units.practice: 混合主梁的設計文件應列出每段的設計單位重、容許偏差與量測方式，並把鋼混分界處的重量與勁度變化納入施工控制；重量偏差超過約 3% 時須由設計者重新評估。~Hybrid-deck documents should list each zone’s design unit weight, tolerance and measurement method and include the weight and stiffness change at the steel–concrete boundary in construction control; deviations beyond about 3% require reassessment by the designer.

units.anchor: 倒 Y 形混凝土塔~Inverted-Y concrete pylons
units.title: 倒 Y 形塔與雙索面的抗扭作用~Inverted-Y pylons and torsional action of two cable planes
units.mechanism: 兩座塔高約 214 m、各重約 20,000 t，為預力混凝土倒 Y 形，兩肢向內傾斜，使塔以受壓為主。兩個斜索面從橋面兩側向上收斂到塔頂，從橫斷面看，斜索、橋面與塔肢形成三角形，橋面若要扭轉，一側斜索必須伸長、另一側縮短，斜索的軸向勁度因此直接提供扭轉勁度。這對主跨 856 m、寬約 23.6 m 的細長橋面非常重要，因為扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率的比值越高，扭轉顫振越不容易發生。~The two pylons are prestressed concrete inverted Y shapes about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each, with legs leaning inward so the pylon works mainly in compression. The two cable planes rise from both deck edges and converge at the pylon head; in cross-section, stays, deck and pylon legs form a triangle, so twisting the deck requires one plane of stays to lengthen and the other to shorten, and their axial stiffness directly supplies torsional stiffness. This matters greatly for an 856 m main span with a deck only about 23.6 m wide, because the higher the ratio of torsional to bending frequency, the less likely torsional flutter becomes.
units.model: 塔肢軸力 N = V/(2cosθ)。若塔頂合計垂直力 V = 400 MN、肢與鉛垂夾角 θ = 10°：N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN；若 θ 增為 20°，N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN，但肢底的水平推力 N·sinθ 由約 35 MN 增至約 73 MN，需由橫梁或基礎承擔。數值為教學假設。~Leg force N = V/(2cosθ). With a total vertical force V = 400 MN at the head and legs at θ = 10° from vertical, N = 400/(2×0.985) ≈ 203 MN; at θ = 20°, N = 400/(2×0.940) ≈ 213 MN, but the horizontal thrust at the leg base, N·sinθ, grows from about 35 MN to about 73 MN, to be carried by a cross beam or the foundation. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以模態分析取得橋面一階垂直彎曲與一階扭轉頻率，計算頻率比並與風洞顫振試驗結果比較；施工中量測兩肢的垂直度與交會點座標，確認斜索錨點位置與設計一致。~Obtain the first vertical bending and torsional frequencies from modal analysis, compute their ratio and compare with flutter test results; during construction survey the verticality of both legs and the coordinates of their meeting point to confirm stay anchor positions match the design.
units.failure: 若改為兩個平行的垂直索面（H 形塔）而未補足扭轉勁度，細長橋面的扭轉頻率下降，顫振臨界風速可能大幅降低；塔肢交會處的局部應力若設計不足，預力或鋼筋配置不當會出現裂縫。~Switching to two parallel vertical cable planes on an H-shaped pylon without compensating torsional stiffness lowers the slender deck’s torsional frequency and can sharply reduce the flutter speed; inadequate design of the leg junction leads to cracking where prestress or reinforcement is poorly arranged.
units.misconception: 塔的形狀只是外觀選擇，對橋面的抗風性能沒有影響。~Pylon shape is purely aesthetic and does not affect the deck’s wind performance.
units.practice: 塔型選擇報告應同時列出頻率比、顫振臨界風速與塔肢內力的比較；塔肢交會區與錨固區的鋼筋、預力配置要以三維模型檢查施工可行性，避免混凝土澆置不密實。~The pylon-form study should compare frequency ratio, flutter speed and leg forces together; reinforcement and prestress at the leg junction and anchorage zone should be checked for buildability in a 3D model to avoid poorly compacted concrete.

units.anchor: 184 根鋼絞線斜索~184 strand stays
units.title: 平行鋼絞線斜索的組成與使用應力~Make-up and service stress of parallel-strand stays
units.mechanism: 官方技術資料列出全橋 184 根斜索（8 組 × 23 根），每根由 31 至 53 股直徑 15.7 mm 的鋼絞線組成，長度約 95 m 至 460 m。每股鋼絞線破斷力約 27 t，使用拉力約 10 t。平行鋼絞線斜索的優點是可以逐股安裝與張拉，不需要一次吊起整根數十噸的成品索，日後也可以逐股抽換；缺點是每股之間的力量必須均勻，否則受力最大的那股會先疲勞或鬆弛。斜索在中央鋼梁段與混凝土段的錨固方式不同，錨具要分別配合鋼錨箱與混凝土錨塊。~The official technical sheet lists 184 stays (8 groups × 23), each made of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm diameter and about 95 m to 460 m long. Each strand has a breaking load of about 27 t and a service tension of about 10 t. Parallel-strand stays can be installed and stressed strand by strand, avoiding lifting a finished cable weighing tens of tonnes, and strands can later be replaced one at a time; the catch is that force must be even among strands, or the most heavily loaded one fatigues or relaxes first. Anchorage differs between the central steel zone and the concrete zones, so anchorages must suit steel anchor boxes and concrete anchor blocks respectively.
units.model: 使用應力比 = 10/27 ≈ 37% 的破斷力；最大 53 股斜索破斷力 53×27 = 1,431 t、使用力 53×10 = 530 t。15.7 mm 鋼絞線截面約 150 mm²，以 1,860 MPa 計破斷力約 279 kN（約 28 t），與官方 27 t 相近。截面與強度等級為教學假設。~Service ratio = 10/27 ≈ 37% of breaking load; the largest 53-strand stay has 53×27 = 1,431 t breaking and 53×10 = 530 t service force. A 15.7 mm strand of about 150 mm² at 1,860 MPa breaks at about 279 kN (about 28 t), close to the official 27 t. Section and grade are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鋼絞線每批做拉伸、鬆弛與疲勞試驗，錨具組裝體依斜索規範做疲勞後破斷試驗；安裝後抽查各股力量的均勻度（例如以單股千斤頂舉升檢測），並記錄每根索的總力與各股最大偏差。~Test each strand lot for tension, relaxation and fatigue and test anchorage assemblies for residual strength after fatigue under stay-cable recommendations; after installation spot-check strand-force uniformity, for example by single-strand lift-off, and record each stay’s total force and maximum strand deviation.
units.failure: 若各股力量不均，受力最大的鋼絞線在活載與風振下承受較大應力幅，可能先在錨口疲勞斷裂，隨後負荷轉移到其他股，形成漸進劣化；錨具夾片咬合不良則可能滑移。~Uneven strand forces subject the most loaded strand to larger stress ranges under traffic and wind vibration, so it may fatigue at the anchor exit first and shift load to others in progressive deterioration; poorly seated wedges can slip.
units.misconception: 斜索只要總索力正確，內部各股鋼絞線的力量分布無關緊要。~As long as the total stay force is right, how force is shared among strands does not matter.
units.practice: 斜索安裝規範要寫明各股力量容許偏差、量測方法與抽查比例，並規定錨具防水帽與填充材料的施工檢查；每根索的安裝紀錄要能追溯到鋼絞線批號。~The stay installation specification should state the allowable strand-force deviation, measurement method and sampling rate and require checks on anchorage caps and filler; each stay’s record must trace back to strand lot numbers.

units.anchor: 塔基 2.10 m 樁群~2.10 m pylon piles
units.title: 塞納河口軟弱地層上的塔基樁群~Pylon pile groups in the soft Seine estuary
units.mechanism: 諾曼第大橋位於塞納河口，表層為軟弱沖積層，塔的巨大垂直力必須以深樁傳到下方承載層。官方技術資料列出塔基礎共 56 根直徑 2.10 m 的樁（表列 4 × 14），總長 2,828 m，深度約 40 至 55 m，每根承載約 3,000 t；南側高架橋墩另有 52 根直徑 1.50 m 的樁。塔肢分開落在兩組樁上，樁群透過厚承台把兩肢的軸力與肢底水平推力整合起來。樁群設計除了承載，還要控制兩肢之間的不均勻沉陷，因為沉陷差會使塔頂偏移並改變斜索力。~The Pont de Normandie stands in the Seine estuary, where soft alluvium overlies the bearing strata, so the pylons’ large vertical forces must travel down deep piles. The official technical sheet lists 56 pylon piles of 2.10 m diameter (tabulated as 4 × 14), 2,828 m in total length, about 40 to 55 m deep and each carrying about 3,000 t; the southern viaduct piers have another 52 piles of 1.50 m. The pylon legs land on separate pile groups, and thick pile caps combine the leg axial forces with the horizontal thrust at the leg bases. Besides capacity, the groups must limit differential settlement between legs, which would tilt the pylon head and change stay forces.
units.model: 若每座塔分配 28 根樁、塔基總垂直力 60,000 t，平均每根 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t，約為單樁承載 3,000 t 的 71%；平均樁長 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m，落在 40 至 55 m 範圍內。總垂直力與每塔樁數分配為教學假設。~If each pylon has 28 piles and a total vertical force of 60,000 t, each pile averages 60,000/28 ≈ 2,143 t, about 71% of the 3,000 t pile capacity; average pile length is 2,828/56 ≈ 50.5 m, within the 40 to 55 m range. Total force and piles per pylon are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以試樁載重試驗確認單樁承載與沉陷，施工時記錄每根樁的鑽掘深度、地層、混凝土灌注量與完整性檢測；塔施工期間量測兩肢基礎的沉陷差，並與設計預測比較。~Confirm single-pile capacity and settlement by load tests on trial piles, record each pile’s drilled depth, strata, concrete volume and integrity test during construction, and measure differential settlement between the two leg foundations as the pylon rises, comparing with design predictions.
units.failure: 若某一肢下方地層較差或樁底清孔不足，兩肢沉陷差使塔頂向一側偏移，斜索力分配隨之改變；河口沖刷若降低樁頂附近的土壤圍束，樁的側向勁度也會下降。~A weaker stratum or poorly cleaned pile bases under one leg cause differential settlement that tilts the pylon head and redistributes stay forces; estuary scour that reduces soil confinement near pile heads also lowers lateral stiffness.
units.misconception: 塔的基礎只要總承載力夠，兩肢之間的沉陷差不重要。~If total capacity is enough, differential settlement between pylon legs does not matter.
units.practice: 樁基施工紀錄應逐根保存並與地層剖面對照，異常樁由設計者評估是否補樁；塔施工期間把兩肢沉陷差列為定期量測項目並設定警戒值。~Keep pile records individually and compare with the ground profile, with the designer deciding on extra piles for anomalous ones; make differential settlement between legs a routine measurement with an alert value during pylon construction.

units.anchor: 近塔混凝土懸臂~Concrete cantilevers near the pylons
units.title: 混凝土段的平衡懸臂施工與預拱~Balanced cantilever construction and camber of the concrete zones
units.mechanism: 主跨兩端的混凝土段由塔向河側伸出約 116 m，向岸側伸出約 96 m，以平衡懸臂方式逐節施作並逐對安裝斜索。混凝土懸臂在施工中持續承受自重與斜索力，彈性變形之外還有收縮與徐變，數年內會繼續下垂或上拱，影響後續鋼梁段的對接高程與完工線形。因此每一節段的模板都要設定預拱值，包含彈性撓度、徐變與收縮的預測，以及後續鋼梁、鋪面荷載造成的變形，讓最終線形符合設計。~The concrete zones at each end of the main span extend about 116 m from the pylon toward the river and about 96 m toward the shore, built by balanced cantilever segment by segment with stays installed in pairs. The concrete cantilever carries self-weight and stay forces throughout construction, and beyond elastic deformation it shrinks and creeps, continuing to sag or rise for years and affecting the connection level of the steel segments and the final profile. Each segment’s formwork is therefore set to a camber that includes predicted elastic deflection, creep and shrinkage and the deformation from later steel and surfacing loads, so that the final profile matches the design.
units.model: 預拱 = 彈性撓度 × (1 + φ)。若某節段在後續施工荷載下的彈性撓度為 60 mm、徐變係數 φ = 2.0，徐變附加 60×2.0 = 120 mm，總預拱約 180 mm；若 φ 只取 1.0，預拱 120 mm，完工後將低於設計線約 60 mm。數值為教學假設。~Camber = elastic deflection × (1 + φ). For a segment with 60 mm elastic deflection under later loads and a creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep adds 60×2.0 = 120 mm for a total camber of about 180 mm; using φ = 1.0 gives 120 mm and leaves the finished deck about 60 mm below the design line. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以實際混凝土的齡期、彈性模數與徐變試驗修正時間相依分析，每節段澆置前後與斜索張拉後量測懸臂端高程；預測與實測偏差超過容許時，調整後續節段的模板預拱或斜索力。~Update the time-dependent analysis with the actual concrete age, modulus and creep tests, and survey cantilever-tip levels before and after each pour and after each stay is stressed; when predicted and measured levels diverge beyond tolerance, adjust the camber of later segments or the stay forces.
units.failure: 若徐變參數估計錯誤，混凝土懸臂端與後續鋼梁的對接高程出現誤差，需強制頂壓或加配重才能對接；完工後線形持續變化，可能造成伸縮縫與鋪面異常。~Wrong creep parameters leave a level mismatch between the concrete cantilever tip and the following steel segments that must be forced together by jacking or ballast; a profile that keeps changing after completion can distress joints and surfacing.
units.misconception: 混凝土橋面澆好後形狀就固定了，不需要考慮之後的變形。~A concrete deck’s shape is fixed once cast; later deformation need not be considered.
units.practice: 每節段的預拱表要列出各項組成並由施工控制工程師簽認，量測固定在清晨溫度均勻時進行；混凝土配比或養護條件改變時，須重新試驗彈性模數與徐變。~Each segment’s camber table should list its components and be signed by the construction-control engineer, with surveys fixed at dawn when temperature is uniform; any change in mix or curing requires new modulus and creep tests.

units.anchor: 19.65 m 鋼節段~19.65 m steel segments
units.title: 鋼節段吊裝與 428 m 懸臂的合龍~Steel segment lifting and closing 428 m cantilevers
units.mechanism: 中央 624 m 鋼梁由 32 個長約 19.65 m 的標準節段加上中央合龍段組成，官方資料列出鋼橋面約 5,600 t、平均每節約 180 t。每個鋼節段吊上懸臂端後先與前一節焊接，再安裝並張拉對應的一對斜索。合龍前，每座塔的懸臂已伸到主跨一半約 428 m，是當時前所未見的長度：懸臂端在新節段吊掛、斜索尚未張拉時會明顯下沉，在風中也會側向擺動。合龍段必須在兩個懸臂端高程、軸線與溫度都吻合的時段放入，並先以臨時連接鎖定。~The central 624 m steel girder comprises 32 standard segments about 19.65 m long plus a central closure segment; the official sheet gives about 5,600 t of steel deck, about 180 t per segment on average. Each steel segment lifted to the cantilever tip is welded to the previous one before its pair of stays is installed and stressed. Before closure each pylon’s cantilever had reached half the main span, about 428 m, an unprecedented length: the tip drops noticeably while a new segment hangs before its stays are stressed, and it sways sideways in wind. The closure segment must go in when the two tips match in level, alignment and temperature, and be locked first with temporary connections.
units.model: 180 t 節段約 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN，若斜索張拉前懸臂端的等效勁度 k = 1,500 kN/m，吊掛時懸臂端下沉 δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m；斜索張拉後應恢復到預定高程。若 k 提高到 2,500 kN/m，δ 約 0.71 m。勁度為教學假設。~A 180 t segment weighs about 180×9.81 ≈ 1,766 kN; with an equivalent tip stiffness k = 1,500 kN/m before its stays are stressed, the tip drops δ = 1,766/1,500 ≈ 1.18 m while the segment hangs, to be recovered by stressing. At k = 2,500 kN/m, δ is about 0.71 m. Stiffness is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每節段吊裝前後、焊接後與斜索張拉後都量測懸臂端高程與軸線，與施工控制模型逐步比對；合龍前連續記錄兩懸臂端的相對高差、間距、溫度與風速，選定合龍時段並以臨時鎖定裝置固定後再焊接。~Survey tip level and alignment before and after each lift, after welding and after stressing, comparing step by step with the construction-control model; before closure continuously record the relative level, gap, temperature and wind at the two tips, choose the closure window and fix the segment with temporary locks before welding.
units.failure: 若吊裝時懸臂端下沉超過預期而急於焊接，節段會以錯誤高程固定，後續斜索力需大幅調整；超長懸臂在強風中缺乏臨時抗風措施，側向擺動可能使吊具與節段碰撞。~Welding in a hurry while the tip has dropped more than expected fixes the segment at the wrong level and forces large later stay adjustments; an extremely long cantilever without temporary wind measures can sway enough in strong wind for rigging and segments to collide.
units.misconception: 斜張橋懸臂每加一節，懸臂端的變形都相同，可以用固定的修正值。~Each added segment deforms the cantilever tip by the same amount, so a fixed correction can be used.
units.practice: 鋼節段的施工控制表要列出每一步的目標高程、容許偏差與對應的斜索張拉力，並規定量測時段與停工風速；合龍作業以停留檢查點管理，由設計與施工控制工程師共同簽認。~The steel-segment control table should list target levels, tolerances and stay forces for every step, with survey times and stop-work wind speeds; closure is managed as a hold point signed jointly by the designer and construction-control engineer.

units.anchor: 現地風場量測~On-site wind measurement
units.title: 現地風量測、紊流與陣風係數~Site wind measurement, turbulence and gust factors
units.mechanism: 法國建築科學技術中心（CSTB）為諾曼第大橋量測了橋址風況並模擬結構的氣動行為。河口開闊、靠近海岸，風速高且紊流明顯；設計時不能只看平均風速，還要知道紊流強度與陣風的空間相關性，因為細長的主梁與長索對短時間的陣風與紊流擾動（抖振）都會反應。現地量測提供平均風速剖面、紊流強度與頻譜，作為風洞試驗流場與抖振分析的輸入；施工期最長懸臂的抗風安全，也依這些統計判斷作業與停工的門檻。~France’s building science centre CSTB measured the wind at the Pont de Normandie site and simulated the structure’s aerodynamic behaviour. The open estuary near the coast brings high winds with marked turbulence; design cannot look only at mean wind speed but must know turbulence intensity and the spatial correlation of gusts, because a slender deck and long stays respond to short gusts and turbulent buffeting. Site measurements provide the mean wind profile, turbulence intensity and spectra used as inputs to wind-tunnel flow and buffeting analysis, and the same statistics set working and stop-work limits for the longest construction cantilever.
units.model: 紊流強度 I_u = σ_u/U。若 10 分鐘平均 U = 32 m/s、標準差 σ_u = 4.8 m/s，I_u = 0.15；以峰值因子 g = 3.5 估算陣風風壓係數 (1 + g·I_u)² = (1 + 3.5×0.15)² ≈ 2.33，即陣風峰值風壓約為平均風壓的 2.3 倍。風速數值為教學假設。~Turbulence intensity I_u = σ_u/U. With a 10-minute mean U = 32 m/s and standard deviation σ_u = 4.8 m/s, I_u = 0.15; with a peak factor g = 3.5, the gust pressure factor is (1 + g·I_u)² = (1 + 3.5×0.15)² ≈ 2.33, so peak gust pressure is about 2.3 times the mean pressure. Wind values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在橋址設置不同高度的超音波風速計長期記錄，計算平均風速、紊流強度、積分尺度與頻譜，與風洞流場模擬比較；施工期以懸臂端的風速計與加速度計同步記錄，驗證抖振反應與分析預測的量級。~Install ultrasonic anemometers at several heights at the site for long-term records, computing mean speed, turbulence intensity, integral scales and spectra for comparison with the wind-tunnel flow; during construction log anemometers and accelerometers at the cantilever tip together to confirm the order of buffeting response against predictions.
units.failure: 若以平滑流風洞試驗代替紊流場，抖振反應會被低估，施工中的大懸臂在中等風速下就出現超出預期的擺動；風速計安裝在受結構遮蔽的位置，則量測值偏低而誤導作業決策。~Testing in smooth flow instead of turbulent flow underestimates buffeting, so the long construction cantilever sways more than expected at moderate wind; anemometers placed in the structure’s wind shadow read low and mislead site decisions.
units.misconception: 只要知道平均風速，就能決定大橋所受的風力。~Knowing the mean wind speed is enough to determine the wind load on a long bridge.
units.practice: 風量測計畫要規定儀器高度、遮蔽距離、取樣率與資料保存，並在設計開始前累積足夠長的紀錄；施工期的停工風速應以陣風而非平均風速表示，並由現場風速計即時通報。~The wind measurement plan should fix instrument heights, clearance from obstructions, sampling rate and data retention, with records long enough before design starts; construction stop-work limits should be expressed as gust rather than mean speeds and reported live from site anemometers.

units.title: 通車後的斜索振動與阻尼器加裝~Post-opening stay vibration and retrofitted dampers
units.mechanism: 諾曼第大橋通車不久，最長的斜索出現過大的振動，管理單位隨即加裝了多套阻尼系統。長索的固有阻尼非常小（往往只有千分之幾），風雨、渦流或橋面運動只要提供少量能量，振幅就會累積到肉眼可見。加裝在橋面附近的外置阻尼器把索的振動能量轉成熱，可達到的最大附加阻尼大約與阻尼器到錨點距離佔索長的比例成正比，所以阻尼器位置受橋面空間限制時，效果有上限。這次經驗也讓後來的斜張橋在設計階段就預留阻尼器與防振措施。~Shortly after the Pont de Normandie opened, its longest stays showed excessive vibration, and several damping systems were quickly retrofitted. The inherent damping of long stays is very small, often only a few thousandths, so a little energy from wind and rain, vortices or deck motion can build amplitudes visible to the eye. External dampers near the deck convert cable vibration energy into heat, and the maximum added damping is roughly proportional to the damper’s distance from the anchorage as a fraction of cable length, so effectiveness has a ceiling when deck space limits the damper position. The experience led later cable-stayed bridges to provide for dampers and vibration measures from the design stage.
units.model: 外置阻尼器最大附加阻尼比 ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L)。若阻尼器裝在離錨點 2.5% 索長處，ζ_max ≈ 0.025/2 = 1.25%，對數遞減率 δ = 2πζ ≈ 7.9%；若空間限制只能裝在 1.5%，ζ_max ≈ 0.75%、δ ≈ 4.7%。位置比例為教學假設。~The maximum added damping of an external damper is ζ_max ≈ x_d/(2L). At 2.5% of cable length from the anchorage, ζ_max ≈ 0.025/2 = 1.25% and the logarithmic decrement δ = 2πζ ≈ 7.9%; if space allows only 1.5%, ζ_max ≈ 0.75% and δ ≈ 4.7%. Position ratios are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 加裝前後以人工激振或自由衰減量測代表性長索的對數遞減率，確認達到設計目標；同時以加速度計記錄風雨事件中的振幅與頻率，比較加裝前後的最大振幅，並定期檢查阻尼器漏油與支架鬆動。~Measure the logarithmic decrement of representative long stays before and after retrofit by manual excitation or free decay to confirm the target; record amplitudes and frequencies during wind–rain events with accelerometers to compare maximum amplitudes before and after, and inspect dampers for leaks and loose brackets periodically.
units.failure: 若不處理長索振動，反覆的大振幅會讓錨口附近的鋼絞線承受彎曲疲勞，HDPE 套管與防水帽磨損失效，水分進入索體；用路人看見斜索劇烈擺動，也會影響對橋梁安全的信心。~Untreated long-stay vibration subjects strands near the anchor exit to bending fatigue and wears out the HDPE duct and caps, letting water into the cable; visible violent stay motion also shakes public confidence in the bridge.
units.misconception: 斜索振動只是外觀問題，不會影響結構壽命。~Stay vibration is only cosmetic and does not affect structural life.
units.practice: 新設計的斜張橋應在設計階段就評估每根索的振動風險，預留阻尼器的安裝空間與錨固細部；既有橋若出現振動，先量測頻率與振幅再選擇阻尼器、交叉索或表面處理，並保存加裝前後的基準資料。~New cable-stayed bridges should assess the vibration risk of every stay at the design stage and reserve damper space and anchorage details; on an existing bridge, measure frequency and amplitude before choosing dampers, cross-ties or surface treatment, and keep baseline data from before and after the retrofit.

units.anchor: 蠟填充與 HDPE 套管~Wax filling and HDPE ducts
units.title: 斜索多層防腐與耐久設計~Multi-layer corrosion protection of the stays
units.mechanism: 諾曼第大橋的斜索以蠟與聚乙烯套管保護，外層再包上具氣動外形的護套。現代鋼絞線斜索的防腐通常是多層屏障：每根鋼絲鍍鋅、鋼絞線外包蠟或油脂並擠壓一層個別的 HDPE 護套，整束再穿入外層 HDPE 套管；錨具區另有防水帽與填充材。多層屏障的意義在於任何單一層破損都不會立即讓鋼材暴露，最外層套管受紫外線、風振磨損與車輛撞擊，最內層的鋅則在水分到達時以犧牲方式保護鋼絲。耐久設計因此重在檢查每一層是否仍完整，而不是等到鋼絲生鏽。~The Pont de Normandie stays are protected by wax and polyethylene sheathing, with an outer cladding of aerodynamic profile. Modern strand stays usually have multi-layer protection: every wire is galvanised, each strand is coated in wax or grease and extruded with its own HDPE sheath, and the bundle runs inside an outer HDPE duct, with waterproof caps and filler at the anchorages. The point of multiple barriers is that no single breach exposes steel at once: the outer duct faces UV, vibration wear and vehicle impact, while the innermost zinc sacrificially protects the wires if water arrives. Durability work therefore focuses on checking that each layer is intact, not on waiting for wires to rust.
units.model: 鍍鋅量 300 g/m² 約相當於 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm 的鋅層。若外層失效、鋅以每年 1 μm 的速率消耗，約 42 年耗盡；若蠟與個別護套仍完整使速率降到每年 0.1 μm，理論壽命延長到約 420 年。鍍鋅量與速率為教學假設。~A zinc coating of 300 g/m² is about 300/7.14 ≈ 42 μm thick. If outer barriers fail and zinc is consumed at 1 μm a year, it lasts about 42 years; if wax and individual sheaths remain intact and slow the rate to 0.1 μm a year, the theoretical life extends to about 420 years. Coating mass and rates are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以繩索技術或檢修車近距離檢查外層套管的裂縫、磨損與接頭；打開錨具防水帽檢查填充物、積水與夾片狀態；依規範在服役約 10 至 20 年後抽取單股鋼絞線做拉伸與腐蝕檢驗，評估內層防護是否仍有效。~Inspect outer ducts at close range by rope access or inspection vehicle for cracks, wear and joints; open anchorage caps to check filler, water and wedges; following recommendations, extract a single strand after about 10 to 20 years of service for tensile and corrosion testing to judge whether the inner protection still works.
units.failure: 套管接頭開裂或錨具防水帽失效，雨水沿索流入下錨頭積聚，鋼絞線在錨口附近局部腐蝕，而這個位置正是應力集中與疲勞最嚴重的地方；外層破損若長期未修補，紫外線與水分會逐層破壞內部防護。~Cracked duct joints or failed caps let rainwater run down into the lower anchorage and pool, corroding strands right at the anchor exit where stress concentration and fatigue are worst; outer damage left unrepaired lets UV and water strip away the inner layers one by one.
units.misconception: 斜索外面有 HDPE 套管，裡面的鋼絞線就永遠不會腐蝕。~With an HDPE duct outside, the strands inside can never corrode.
units.practice: 檢查手冊要把錨具區列為重點，規定防水帽開啟的週期與排水孔檢查；任何套管破損都應在下一個維護週期內修補，並記錄位置以追蹤是否反覆發生。~The inspection manual should prioritise anchorage zones, set intervals for opening caps and checking drain holes, repair any duct damage within the next maintenance cycle and record its location to track recurrence.

units.title: 逐股更換、營運管理與工程交接~Strand-by-strand replacement, operation and handover
units.mechanism: 平行鋼絞線斜索的一大優點是可以在不拆除整根索的情況下逐股抽換。抽出一股時，它原本承擔的力量會平均轉移到同一根索的其餘鋼絞線，總索力幾乎不變，因此可以在維持交通的情況下進行；新股穿入後以單股千斤頂張拉到與其他股相同的力量。諾曼第大橋由業主公會管理收費與維護，與鄰近的唐卡維爾懸索橋同屬一個營運體系。營運期的交接資料必須讓維護團隊知道每根索的股數、各股原始力量、錨具型號與防護層構造，才能安全規劃抽換。~A major advantage of parallel-strand stays is that strands can be replaced one at a time without removing the whole cable. When one strand is withdrawn, its force spreads evenly over the remaining strands of the same stay and the total force barely changes, so work can proceed under traffic; the new strand is threaded in and stressed by a mono-strand jack to match the others. The Pont de Normandie’s owner manages tolls and maintenance together with the nearby Tancarville suspension bridge. Handover data must tell the maintenance team each stay’s strand count, original strand forces, anchorage type and protection build-up so that replacements can be planned safely.
units.model: 53 股斜索每股 10 t，抽出一股後其餘 52 股各增加 1/52 ≈ 1.9%，即每股約 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t，仍遠低於 27 t 破斷力；若同時抽出 3 股，每股增至約 10×53/50 = 10.6 t。數值為教學假設。~In a 53-strand stay at 10 t per strand, withdrawing one strand raises each of the other 52 by 1/52 ≈ 1.9%, to about 10×53/52 ≈ 10.19 t, far below the 27 t breaking load; withdrawing 3 at once raises each to about 10×53/50 = 10.6 t. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 抽換前以單股舉升檢測確認各股現況力量，抽換中監測索的總力與相鄰索變化，新股張拉後再以舉升檢測確認與其他股一致；抽出的舊股送實驗室做拉伸、腐蝕與疲勞檢驗，作為整體狀況評估依據。~Before replacement, confirm current strand forces by single-strand lift-off; during the work monitor the stay’s total force and neighbouring stays; after stressing the new strand confirm by lift-off that it matches the others; send the removed strand to a laboratory for tensile, corrosion and fatigue tests as evidence of overall condition.
units.failure: 若新股張拉力與其他股差異過大，受力較大的股會成為新的弱點；抽換作業未管制交通與風速，單股千斤頂與錨具區作業可能受振動干擾，增加夾片咬合不良的風險。~A new strand stressed far from the others becomes a new weak point; work without traffic and wind control lets vibration disturb mono-strand jacking at the anchorage, raising the risk of poorly seated wedges.
units.misconception: 斜索出問題時只能整根更換，必須封閉大橋。~A problem stay can only be replaced as a whole cable with the bridge closed.
units.practice: 交接資料應包含每根索的股數、安裝力量、鋼絞線批號、錨具與防護層圖說；抽換作業須有方法說明、交通與風速條件、力量容許偏差與停工條件，並由主管工程師核准後執行。~Handover should include each stay’s strand count, installation forces, strand lot numbers and drawings of anchorage and protection; replacement work requires a method statement, traffic and wind conditions, force tolerances and stop criteria, approved by the responsible engineer before execution.

example: 設計練習：估算鋼與混凝土兩種中央段方案對單根長索的影響。設主跨中央某根長索負擔 19.65 m 的節段，鋼橋面 10 t/m 時恆載 W = 19.65×10 ≈ 197 t（約 1,930 kN）；若改為 40 t/m 的混凝土，W = 786 t（約 7,710 kN）。斜索與水平夾角 θ = 25°，sin25° ≈ 0.423，鋼方案索力 T = 1,930/0.423 ≈ 4,560 kN，混凝土方案 T ≈ 7,710/0.423 ≈ 18,240 kN。以每股使用拉力 10 t（約 98 kN）計，鋼方案需約 4,560/98 ≈ 47 股，混凝土方案需約 186 股，超過 53 股的上限三倍以上。若夾角提高到 30°（sin30° = 0.5），鋼方案索力降為約 3,860 kN、約 40 股。數值為教學假設，未計活載與動力效應。~Design exercise: compare the effect of steel and concrete central zones on one long stay. Suppose a long stay near mid-span supports a 19.65 m segment; at 10 t/m for a steel deck the dead load is W = 19.65×10 ≈ 197 t (about 1,930 kN), while a 40 t/m concrete deck gives W = 786 t (about 7,710 kN). At θ = 25° to the horizontal, sin25° ≈ 0.423, so the steel option needs T = 1,930/0.423 ≈ 4,560 kN and the concrete option T ≈ 7,710/0.423 ≈ 18,240 kN. At a service tension of 10 t (about 98 kN) per strand, the steel option needs about 4,560/98 ≈ 47 strands and the concrete option about 186, more than three times the 53-strand maximum. Raising the angle to 30° (sin30° = 0.5) lowers the steel option to about 3,860 kN, about 40 strands. Values are teaching assumptions excluding live load and dynamic effects.
history: 為連接勒阿弗爾與翁弗勒爾、跨越塞納河口，勒阿弗爾工商會推動興建諾曼第大橋，由 Michel Virlogeux 主導設計，Bouygues 的 Bernard Raspaud 負責總體研究，1988 年起施工、1994 年完成主體，1995 年 1 月 20 日通車。當時 856 m 的主跨比前一紀錄長逾 250 m，靠的是混合主梁、倒 Y 形塔與流線形箱梁，CSTB 則提供現地風量測與氣動研究；1999 年跨徑紀錄被日本多多羅大橋打破。通車後長索振動促成阻尼器加裝，成為斜索防振的重要案例。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。~To cross the Seine estuary between Le Havre and Honfleur, the Le Havre Chamber of Commerce and Industry promoted the Pont de Normandie, designed under Michel Virlogeux with general studies led by Bernard Raspaud of Bouygues; construction began in 1988, the main works were finished in 1994 and the bridge opened on 20 January 1995. Its 856 m span beat the previous record by more than 250 m thanks to the hybrid deck, inverted-Y pylons and a streamlined box, with CSTB providing site wind measurements and aerodynamic studies; Japan’s Tatara Bridge took the span record in 1999. Long-stay vibration after opening led to retrofitted dampers, making the bridge a key case in stay vibration control. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
facts: 主跨 856 m = 116 m 混凝土 + 624 m 鋼 + 116 m 混凝土~The 856 m main span is 116 m concrete + 624 m steel + 116 m concrete
倒 Y 形混凝土塔高約 214 m，每座約 20,000 t~The inverted-Y concrete pylons are about 214 m tall and about 20,000 t each
共 184 根斜索（8×23），每根 31 至 53 股 15.7 mm 鋼絞線~There are 184 stays (8×23), each of 31 to 53 strands of 15.7 mm
最短斜索約 95 m，最長約 460 m~Stays range from about 95 m to 460 m long
每股鋼絞線的破斷力約 27 t，使用拉力約 10 t~Each strand breaks at about 27 t with a service tension of about 10 t
鋼橋面約 5,600 t，由 32 個約 19.65 m 標準節段與中央合龍段組成~The steel deck is about 5,600 t, made of 32 standard segments of about 19.65 m plus a central closure
混凝土橋面每公尺約 33 至 50 t，鋼橋面約 8 至 11 t~The concrete deck weighs about 33 to 50 t per metre and the steel deck about 8 to 11 t
橋面寬約 23.6 m，最高水位時淨空超過 50 m~The deck is about 23.6 m wide with over 50 m clearance at highest water
塔基共 56 根直徑 2.10 m 樁，深約 40 至 55 m，每根承載約 3,000 t~The pylons stand on 56 piles of 2.10 m diameter, about 40 to 55 m deep, each carrying about 3,000 t
